verses.geez: ወእመኒ፡ ሤሙከ፡ መልአከ፡ ኢታዕቢ፡ ርእሰከ፡ ኩን፡ ከማሆሙ፡ ከመ፡ ፩ዱ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ወተክዝ፡ ትካዞሙ፡ ወንበር።
verses.translation: If thou be made the master [of a feast], lift not thyself up, but be among them as one of the rest; take diligent care for them, and so sit down.

translations.lxx: If thou be made the master [of a feast], lift not thyself up, but be among them as one of the rest; take diligent care for them, and so sit down.
translations.ron: Cel care păzeşte legea înmulţeşte jertfele.

verses.geez: ኰንኖሙ፡ ከመ፡ ትርከብ፡ አክሊለ፡ ክብር፡ ፈጺመከ፡ መልእክተከ።
verses.translation: And when thou hast done all thy office, take thy place, that thou mayest be merry with them, and receive a crown for thy well ordering of the feast.

translations.lxx: And when thou hast done all thy office, take thy place, that thou mayest be merry with them, and receive a crown for thy well ordering of the feast.
translations.ron: Jertfeşte jertfă de împăcare cel care ia aminte la porunci.

verses.geez: ንብብ፡ አረጋዊ፡ ወይደልወከ፡ ወኢትጸመም፡ ለሠናይ፡ ነገር፡ ትምህርተ፡ ጥበብከ።
verses.translation: Speak, thou that art the elder, for it becometh thee, but with sound judgment; and hinder not music.

translations.lxx: Speak, thou that art the elder, for it becometh thee, but with sound judgment; and hinder not music.
translations.ron: Şi cel care mulţumeşte este ca şi cel care aduce jertfă făină curată de grâu; şi cel care face milostenia este ca şi cel care jertfeşte jertfă de laudă.

verses.geez: ኢታይድዕ፡ ቃለከ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዘሐተተከ፡ ወኢትጠበብ፡ በከመ፡ ረከብከ።
verses.translation: Pour not out words where there is a musician, and shew not forth wisdom out of time.

translations.lxx: Pour not out words where there is a musician, and shew not forth wisdom out of time.
translations.ron: Plăcut este Domnului când te depărtezi de răutate şi jertfă cu curăţenie este când te desparţi de strâmbătate.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ዕንቊ፡ ክቡር፡ ውስተ፡ ሰርጐ፡ ወርቅ፡ ከማሁ፡ ማሕሌት፡ በኀበ፡ ይሰትዩ፡ ወይነ።
verses.translation: A concert of music in a banquet of wine is as a signet of carbuncle set in gold.

translations.lxx: A concert of music in a banquet of wine is as a signet of carbuncle set in gold.
translations.ron: Să nu te arăţi în faţa Domnului cu mâinile goale, că toate jertfele sunt din porunca legii.

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ መረግድ፡ ውስተ፡ ባዝግና፡ ወርቅ፡ ከማሁ፡ ሐዋዝ፡ ማሕሌት፡ ወመሰንቆ፡ በቤተ፡ ስታይ።
verses.translation: As a signet of an emerald set in a work of gold, so is the melody of music with pleasant wine.

translations.lxx: As a signet of an emerald set in a work of gold, so is the melody of music with pleasant wine.
translations.ron: Jertfa dreptului unge jertfelnicul şi mirosul ei bun este înaintea Celui Preaînalt.

verses.geez: ንብብ፡ ወሬዛ፡ ለእመ፡ አብሑከ፡ እምዕጹብ፡ ንግር፡ ሶበ፡ ዳግመ፡ ተስእሉከ።
verses.translation: Speak, young man, if there be need of thee: and yet scarcely when thou art twice asked.

translations.lxx: Speak, young man, if there be need of thee: and yet scarcely when thou art twice asked.
translations.ron: Jertfa bărbatului drept este primită şi pomenirea ei nu se va uita.

verses.geez: ምዕረ፡ አውሢአከ፡ ሶቤሃ፡ ፈጽም፡ ቃለከ፡ ወእንዘ፡ ታአምር፡ አርምም፡ አፉከ።
verses.translation: Let thy speech be short, comprehending much in few words; be as one that knoweth and yet holdeth his tongue.

translations.lxx: Let thy speech be short, comprehending much in few words; be as one that knoweth and yet holdeth his tongue.
translations.ron: Cu ochi buni slăveşte pe Domnul şi să nu împuţinezi pârga mâinilor tale.

verses.geez: ወኢትንበር፡ ማእከለ፡ ዐበይት፡ እንዘ፡ ባዕድ፡ ይነግር፡ ኢታይድዕ፡ ቃለከ።
verses.translation: If thou be among great men, make not thyself equal with them; and when ancient men are in place, use not many words.

translations.lxx: If thou be among great men, make not thyself equal with them; and when ancient men are in place, use not many words.
translations.ron: Totdeauna când dai, fii cu faţă voioasă şi cu bucurie sfinţeşte zeciuiala.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ይረውጽ፡ መብረቅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ነጐድጓድ፡ ከማሁ፡ ሞገሱ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ለዘየኀፍር።
verses.translation: Before the thunder goeth lightning; and before a shamefaced man shall go favour.

translations.lxx: Before the thunder goeth lightning; and before a shamefaced man shall go favour.
translations.ron: Dă Celui Preaînalt, precum ţi-a dat El, şi dă din toată inima din câştigul mâinilor tale,

verses.geez: ኵሎ፡ በጊዜሁ፡ ወበዐቅሙ፡ ግበር፡ አቲወከ፡ ቤተከ፡ ወበህ፡ ተፈሣሕ።
verses.translation: Rise up betimes, and be not the last; but get thee home without delay.

translations.lxx: Rise up betimes, and be not the last; but get thee home without delay.
translations.ron: Că Domnul este răsplătitor şi cu şapte părţi îţi va răsplăti.

verses.geez: ወተዋነይ፡ ወግበር፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘመፍትው፡ ዘትፈቅድ፡ ዑቅ፡ ኢትንብብ፡ ነገረ፡ ትዕቢት፡ ወኢተአብስ፡ በቃልከ።
verses.translation: There take thy pastime, and do what thou wilt: but sin not by proud speech.

translations.lxx: There take thy pastime, and do what thou wilt: but sin not by proud speech.
translations.ron: Nu Îl cumpăra cu daruri, că nu le va primi.

verses.geez: ምስለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ አእኵቶ፡ ለፈጣሪከ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ያጸግበከ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ በረከቱ።
verses.translation: And for these things bless him that made thee, and hath replenished thee with his good things.

translations.lxx: And for these things bless him that made thee, and hath replenished thee with his good things.
translations.ron: Nu nădăjdui în jertfa nedreaptă, că Domnul este judecător şi nu este la El părtinire.

verses.geez: ዘይፈርሆ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ይገኒ፡ ለተግሣጹ፡ ወእለኒ፡ ይገይሱ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ይረክቡ፡ ፍትወቶሙ።
verses.translation: Whoso feareth the Lord will receive his discipline; and they that seek him early shall find favour.

translations.lxx: Whoso feareth the Lord will receive his discipline; and they that seek him early shall find favour.
translations.ron: Nu va primi Domnul pe cel care asupreşte pe sărac, iar rugăciunea celui asuprit o va asculta.

verses.geez: ወዘየኀሥሦ፡ ለሕጉ፡ ይጸግብ፡ እምውስቴቱ፡ ወዘሰ፡ ይናፍቅ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይወድቅ፡ ወይጌጊ።
verses.translation: He that seeketh the law shall be filled therewith: but the hypocrite will be offended thereat.

translations.lxx: He that seeketh the law shall be filled therewith: but the hypocrite will be offended thereat.
translations.ron: Nu va trece cu vederea rugăciunea sărmanului şi nici pe văduvă când I se va jelui.

verses.geez: እለ፡ ይፈርህዎ፡ ለእግዘአብሔር፡ ይፈትሕ፡ ሎሙ፡ ወቀትረ፡ መዓልት፡ ይትቤቀል፡ በቀሎሙ።
verses.translation: They that fear the Lord shall find judgment, and shall kindle justice as a light.

translations.lxx: They that fear the Lord shall find judgment, and shall kindle justice as a light.
translations.ron: Oare nu curg lacrimile văduvei pe obraz? Strigarea ei asupra celui care i le-a stors va fi auzită.

verses.geez: ወብእሲሰ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ኢያፀምእ፡ ዘይጌሥጽዎ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ከማሁ፡ ይመስሎ፡ በልቡ።
verses.translation: A sinful man will not be reproved, but findeth an excuse according to his will.

translations.lxx: A sinful man will not be reproved, but findeth an excuse according to his will.
translations.ron: Cel care slujeşte lui Dumnezeu, cu bunăvoinţă va fi primit şi rugăciunea lui până la nori va ajunge.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይገብር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ምክር፡ ፀራይ፡ ወዕቡይ፡ ዘይቴክዝ፡ ፍርሀተ፡ ይገብር፡ እንበለ፡ ምክር።
verses.translation: A man of counsel will be considerate; but a strange and proud man is not daunted with fear, even when of himself he hath done without counsel.

translations.lxx: A man of counsel will be considerate; but a strange and proud man is not daunted with fear, even when of himself he hath done without counsel.
translations.ron: Rugăciunea celui smerit va pătrunde norii şi nu se va mângâia până nu va ajunge acolo.

verses.geez: ወአንተሰ፡ ወልድየአልቦ፡ ዘትገብር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ምክር፡ ወዘኒ፡ ገበርከ፡ ኢታማስን።
verses.translation: Do nothing without advice; and when thou hast once done, repent not.

translations.lxx: Do nothing without advice; and when thou hast once done, repent not.
translations.ron: Şi nu se va depărta până ce va lua aminte Cel Preaînalt şi va face judecată cu dreptate şi dreptatea va da-o.

verses.geez: ወኢትሖር፡ ፍኖተ፡ በዳ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትትዐቀፍ፡ በእብነ፡ መንሱት።
verses.translation: Go not in a way wherein thou mayest fall, and stumble not among the stones.

translations.lxx: Go not in a way wherein thou mayest fall, and stumble not among the stones.
translations.ron: Şi Domnul nu va zăbovi, nici va îndelunga răbdarea peste ei, până nu va zdrobi mijlocul celor nemilostivi.

verses.geez: ኢትተአመኖ፡ ለጸላኢከ፡ በሐቅል።
verses.translation: Be not confident in a plain way.

translations.lxx: Be not confident in a plain way.
translations.ron: Şi neamurilor va răsplăti cu pedeapsă, până ce va strica mulţimea batjocoritorilor şi sceptrele nelegiuiţilor le va zdrobi;

verses.geez: ወኢትትአመን፡ ወልደከሂ፡ ዘኢየሐውር፡ በግዕዝከ።
verses.translation: And beware of thine own children.

translations.lxx: And beware of thine own children.
translations.ron: Până ce va răsplăti omului după lucrurile lui şi lucrurilor oamenilor după gândurile lor;

verses.geez: ወበኵሉ፡ ዘገበርከ፡ አስተፍሥሓ፡ ለነፍስከ፡ ወበኵሉ፡ ዕቀብ፡ ትእዛዞ።
verses.translation: In every good work trust thy own soul; for this is the keeping of the commandments.

translations.lxx: In every good work trust thy own soul; for this is the keeping of the commandments.
translations.ron: Până ce va judeca judecata poporului Său şi-l va veseli cu mila Sa.

verses.geez: ዘይፈርህ፡ ሕጎ፡ ያፀምእ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ መጽሐፉ፡ ወዘይትአመን፡ በእግዚአብሔር፡ አልቦ፡ ዘየኀጥእ።
verses.translation: He that believeth in the Lord taketh heed to the commandment; and he that trusteth in him shall fare never the worse.

translations.lxx: He that believeth in the Lord taketh heed to the commandment; and he that trusteth in him shall fare never the worse.
translations.ron: Frumoasă este mila în vremea necazului poporului lui, ca norii cei de ploaie în vremea secetei.
